title: Why You Feel Guilty When You Rest
description:
You finally have a free afternoon. So why does sitting down feel wrong?

One quiet Sunday, a book keeps getting pushed aside by dishes, emails, and “just one more thing.” This illustrated story explores the guilt that can follow us into our free time—and the small choices that let an ordinary afternoon belong to us again.

Watch next: Why Being Helpful Leaves You Overwhelmed
https://youtu.be/j_WvrjeqU_w

Modern Life Inc. — Understand people. Understand modern life.
Original fictional stories about everyday behavior, relationships, and modern life.

Research informing one part of this episode:
Tonietto, Malkoc, Reczek & Norton (2021), Viewing leisure as wasteful undermines enjoyment.
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jesp.2021.104198
